name: msc-event-registration-system
description: Production-Ready Microsoft-Themed Event Registration & Queue Management System

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.render-build: cd client && npm install && npm run build && cd ../server && npm install && npx prisma generate && npm run build && npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss
scripts.prisma:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev
